title: A rapid and simple method for the extraction of biogenic silica in phytolith-poor sediments and soils
author: Mazuy, Ferrara, et al.
materials: Vortex mixer (IKA Janke & Kunkel Labortechnik VF2)

Fresh demineralised water has a high capacity of deflocculating when coupled with magnetic stirring. Furthermore, such a procedure can guarantee a faster and more controlled approach to deflocculation than through the use of a chemical deflocculant.
Recycle diluted Na6 solution from the rinsing process.

steps.title: Weigh sample and add water
steps.instruction: Weigh 3.5 g of untreated sediment into a 50 mL centrifuge tube, add fresh demineralised water, and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Deflocculate and sieve sample
steps.instruction: Deflocculate the sample in 250 mL of fresh demineralised water with magnetic stirring for 5–6 hours, then sieve through a 200 µm mesh into 50 mL centrifuge tubes, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Acid treatment and rinse
steps.instruction: Add 33 % HCl dropwise until the total volume reaches 14 mL, place the tubes in an 80 °C water bath for 15 min, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and discard the supernatant; then rinse the pellet three times with fresh demineralised water by adding water, vortex 5 s (or until fully dispersed), centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and discard the supernatant each time.

steps.title: Alkali treatment and rinse
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL of 10 % KOH, vortex 5 s, incubate in an 80 °C water bath for 15 min, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and discard the supernatant; subsequently rinse the pellet at least six times with fresh demineralised water (vortex 5 s, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm) until the supernatant is clear, discarding each wash; optionally pipette out any remaining drops.

steps.title: Heavy‑liquid separation and cleaning
steps.instruction: Prepare a sodium metatungstate (Na6) solution of density 2.35 g mL⁻¹; add a volume equal to twice the sediment volume in the tube, vortex for ≥15 min, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and collect the supernatant containing phytoliths in a new tube (store leftover at 4 °C). Dilute the collected supernatant with fresh demineralised water (2 × the volume of Na6 supernatant), vortex ≥5 min, centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm; repeat the dilution step twice. Rinse the pellet three times with fresh demineralised water (vortex 5 s, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm) and recycle the Na6 solution from the rinses.

steps.title: Oxidative cleaning and final rinse
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of 30 % H₂O₂, vortex 10 s, incubate in an 80 °C water bath for 1 h (shorten if vigorous reaction), centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm and discard the supernatant; repeat up to three times if needed. Then rinse the pellet 2–3 times with fresh demineralised water (vortex 5 s, centrifuge 5 min at 2000 rpm).

steps.title: Dry and store phytoliths
steps.instruction: Dry the phytolith pellet at room temperature (or in a moderate‑temperature drying oven) and preserve the dried material in glycerol at room temperature.
